item.title: Pakistan launches strikes on Afghanistan; Taliban says civilians killed in hospital attack
item.description: Afghanistan accused Pakistan of killing civilians in fresh airstrikes on Kabul, alleging a hospital treating drug addicts was hit. Pakistan denied targeting civilians, stating precision strikes hit military and "terrorist" targets used against Pakistan. Tensions escalate amid ongoing border clashes and accusations of sheltering militants.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE arrests man for trespassing, filming in restricted Fujairah areas without permit
item.description: UAE authorities have arrested an individual for filming in restricted areas without a permit, highlighting a crackdown on unauthorised content creation amid rising regional tensions. This incident underscores strict regulations against capturing sensitive infrastructure or security details, with legal consequences even without proven harmful intent. The clear message is to prioritise permits before filming.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE sends emergency missile alert: Dubai confirms sounds heard across emirate were successful air defence interception amid Iran vs US-Israel war
item.description: UAE residents received rare emergency alerts for a potential missile threat, followed by loud sounds across Dubai. Authorities clarified these were successful air defence interceptions, not impacts. This incident, a direct consequence of escalating Iran vs US-Israel war, saw hundreds of aerial threats neutralised, highlighting the proximity of war to the Gulf and the importance of staying informed through official channels.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Iran confirms death of national security chief Ali Larijani, president Pezeshkian offers condolences
item.description: Iran confirmed the death of national security chief Ali Larijani and military figure Gholamreza Soleimani, hours after Israel claimed responsibility for airstrikes. Prime Minister Netanyahu identified Larijani as a key leader of the Revolutionary Guards. Iran's president mourned the loss and vowed revenge, while vowing to continue resistance.
item.dc:creator: TOI News Desk

item.title: Eid ul Fitr 2026 free parking for 3 days: Metro, tram, full schedule of public transport timings by Dubai RTA inside
item.description: Dubai's Eid ul Fitr 2026 celebrations will see extended metro and tram services, running until 1:00 am daily, with earlier starts for morning prayers. Free public parking will be available for the first three days of Eid, excluding multi-storey facilities. These adjusted timings aim to manage the festive rush and enhance mobility across the emirate.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Eid ul Fitr 2026 on Friday' trends online: Do we pray twice? UAE Fatwa Council clarifies as prayer confusion goes viral
item.description: As Eid ul Fitr potentially falls on a Friday in 2026, the UAE Fatwa Council clarifies that both Eid and Jummah prayers are obligatory and must be performed separately. This ruling emphasises the distinct significance of each prayer, reinforcing consistency in religious observance and communal worship for Muslims in the UAE.

item.title: Kick Bans Ac7ionMan as Viral Video Fuels Relapse Rumors and Streamer’s Explanation Leaves Viewers Questioning Everything
item.description: Ac7ionMan has been banned from Kick after a viral video led to claims of a fentanyl relapse. The streamer denied the claim, saying he took an over-the-counter pill without knowing its strength. His channel was removed the same day, and he later confirmed a 14-day ban while trying to get it reduced.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Streamer ERBY’s cage stream sparks controversy as Twitch issues ban over dangerous stunt
item.description: Streamer ERBY faced bans on both Twitch and Kick after a controversial "dog crate challenge." Viewers paid him to remain in a dog crate for extended periods and perform dangerous stunts, including consuming extremely spicy sauce. Twitch cited violations of their community guidelines against self-harm and harmful acts, leading to his account termination.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: YouTube asks viewers to rate “AI slop” videos amid growing AI content concerns
item.description: YouTube is now asking users to identify "AI slop" videos, which are quickly generated, low-quality content. This move aims to combat spam and improve viewer experience by better recommending or removing such videos. The platform is actively working to balance AI advancements with content quality and safety for its audience.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Zakat al Fitr payment before Eid ul Fitr 2026 prayers explained: Who must pay, when, how much and the deadline you can’t miss
item.description: Ramadan 2026 brings focus to Zakat al Fitr, a vital Muslim charity. In the UAE, the amount is set at Dh25 per person or equivalent food. This obligation ensures that the less fortunate can celebrate Eid with dignity as payments are due before Eid prayers. Approved channels facilitate transparent distribution. This tradition highlights compassion and collective care.

item.title: Can your UAE employer stop your salary if you are stranded outside the emirates amid Iran vs US-Israel war? Here’s what the law really says
item.description: Geopolitical tensions have left many expatriates stranded abroad, raising questions about salary continuation. UAE labour law dictates salary is tied to work but unavoidable absences due to conflict or travel bans are considered justified. Outcomes depend on remote work capability, employer agreement and clear communication, with flexibility and negotiation being key.
